1.actDes:
The rampant plague has turned an entire legion into Blights. Now, summon the alliance members to eradicate this fallen legion and end the threat.
1. During the event, when the number of members with a Sanctuary Lv.6 or higher in the alliance reaches 10, R4 Officials/R5 can initiate it.
2. During the event, you can launch attacks on the Blight Camp. When the camp's health reaches 0, it will be defeated. Each member can challenge the Monster 3 times a day, with attempts resetting the next day.
3. When the first 5 levels of the camp are defeated, [c][118c11]Alliance Chests[-][/c] will be unlocked, and all alliance members can claim them.
4. Alliance members with [c][118c11]Buff Heroes[-][/c] will have enhanced Hero Stats in their attack teams during the expedition.
5. During the event, the damage dealt to Monsters will be accumulated, and reaching the required tier will grant personal damage rewards.
6. After the event, rankings will be based on alliance progress and personal damage within the server, and ranking rewards will be distributed.
